integrity: The all-finite-group theorem is justified by a combinatorial proof; an executable finite-case checker corroborates it but is not used as an infinite certificate. Scientific priority and independent validation are unverified.
scientific_limitations: Pointed finite G-sets only. Counts nilpotent maps, not exact-index or conjugacy classes. Recovering the table of marks presupposes orbit-type labels and cardinalities and does not imply reconstruction of G. Finite test cases do not establish generality or historical priority; implicit coverage by a general forest theorem or wreath-product result cannot be excluded.
title: Nilpotent equivariant endomorphisms: an orbit-type forest product and reconstruction of the table of marks
